node.title: OCELOT science research guidance: results and scope reporting

node.boundary: Synthetic case: target response observed in 7 of 12 episodes; negative control omitted; positive control has zero detectable response; independent-run count unspecified.
node.state: Only the stated aggregate and control outcomes are available; no control contrast, sampling uncertainty, or independent-run structure is supplied.
node.rules: Interpretation requires a functioning/alive measurement arm and calibrated instrument; treatment inference requires valid comparison controls and prospective confirmatory design.
node.grammar: Episode-level response/no-response summaries plus target, negative-control, and positive-control arms.
node.possibilities: Observed target activity may be target-associated, background/noise, or an artifact of an insensitive/dead assay; supplied data cannot discriminate these possibilities.
node.realisation: 7/12 target episodes responded; negative control absent; positive control response 0 detectable.
node.residual: No estimate of treatment effect versus control, no demonstrated assay sensitivity, and no independent-run replication count.
node.cost: A follow-up must calibrate the readout and run prospectively specified, adequately powered independent runs.
node.grounding: Hypothetical empirical measurement; response definition and episode dependence are unspecified.
node.test: Calibrate random-input floor and ideal-exemplar ceiling, demonstrate non-zero positive-control response, include negative control, then conduct preregistered confirmatory comparison and report nulls/scope.

node.wording: The case establishes only that the target response was recorded in 7 of 12 stated episodes; it does not establish a confirmatory treatment effect.
node.scope: This hypothetical case and its stated outcomes only.
node.author: research evaluation
node.limitations: The numerator/denominator are descriptive; controls are inadequate for causal attribution and independent-run count is unknown.

node.wording: A treatment effect may exist, but this case cannot determine its direction or magnitude because there is no negative-control comparison and the positive-control failure leaves assay/arm viability unestablished.
node.scope: Plausible explanations consistent with the limited case record.

node.wording: The synthetic record reports 7/12 target episodes, no negative control, and zero detectable positive-control response; this supports only the descriptive count and leaves causal attribution unidentified.
node.limitations: Not independently replicated; episodes may not be independent; the response measure and uncertainty are unspecified.

node.wording: The instrument gate requires random-input floor and ideal-exemplar ceiling checks and states that arms must be alive, demonstrated with non-zero positive-control responses; a gate passing a dead arm is invalid.
node.limitations: Guidance specifies validity checks but does not supply measurements for this case.

node.wording: Before a confirmatory claim, prospectively preregister the two-sided hypothesis, exact statistic/readout, sample size fixed by power analysis, claimed clean seeds, decision rule, tests, and provisos; report failures/nulls and scope.
node.limitations: This is procedural guidance, not evidence that any treatment works.
